PAVAN KUMAR SARMA A. Business Analyst | AI Enabled Credit and

Banking | Regulatory Technology

Email: pavankumarsarmaannadanam@gmail.com Ph: 6300847415

Professional Summary Business Analyst with 14 years of experience in banking technology, credit risk, lending, regulatory compliance (KYC/AML, Basel, CCAR), Investment Banking and core banking platforms across APAC, EMEA, and North America. Proven expertise in gathering and analysing requirements, documenting BRDs/FRDs, mapping workflows, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to modernize legacy systems and launch digital solutions. Skilled in Agile delivery, stakeholder communication, and data-driven analysis to ensure compliance and operational efficiency. Certified CSPO, ACSPO, and IIBA credentials (JAIIB, CAIIB).

Educational Qualifications & Certifications • MBA & PGDM (2 years): FHWS Germany & Christ University, Bangalore – 2011 • B.Tech. Electrical & Electronics, Vidya Jyothi Institute of Technology (JNTU Hyderabad- 2008 • CSPO, ACSPO certified •

IIBA certificates – JAIIB; CAIIB

Key Skills & Tools • Functional: Requirements Gathering (BRD, FRD), Gap Analysis, UAT/SIT, Data Mapping, Impact Analysis | Product Management - User Experience, Product Design & ownership | Business Analysis, Business Requirements Gathering (BRD, FRD) UAT & SIT | Data Mapping, Impact Analysis| Management, Stakeholder Management & Product Management

Domain Expertise: Core Banking, Retail Lending,Investbanking,Treasury Operations, Merchant onboarding workflows, Settlement systems and reporting dashboards, RBI/NCPI compliance and reconciliation workflows.

Technical: JIRA, Confluence, Cross Team Dashboards, Visio, Tableau, Power BI, Draw.io, Sequence diagrams, Created PD- Probability of Default/LGD – Loss Given Default/EAD - Exposure at Default models to understand credit workflows, and also to arrive at UNCO calculations, Expected loss for regulatory compliance like Basel; IFRS, OPTIMA and CCAR reporting, Finacle 10.2, FINS, FETRUM.

Stakeholder Management: Cross-functional collaboration, workshops, training, documentation, and reporting

Professional Experience

VIRTUSA | Lead Business Analyst (Client: Citi Bank) Jul’23 – Present

Currently working at Virtusa as Lead Business Analyst associated with CITI Bank projects for Modernizing the legacy systems – Credit risk rating for HNI/UHNI’s; NAV bulk Upload; Digital Credit Memo & Quality Control Checklist and UNCO (Unused Commitment Amount) to meet the OPTIMA, CRE CCAR reporting requirements of the bank.

▪ Lead end-to-end development of Trade Lifecycle in building Global Lending System Risk Rating User Interface common to all the regions across globe for CITI BANK ‘s HNI/UHNI customer risk rating. This is an automated unified digital interface which reduces manual effort

and improved compliance (OPTIMA reporting compliance) across APAC, EMEA, and NAM regions.

▪ Collaborated with engineering team to digitalize the manual Credit Memo and Quality Control Checklist, which involved the re-design of the credit workflows, driving architectural decisions to improve the system scalability and data integrity. Involved in Data & Automation –Designed the logic for auto updating the NAV bulk uploads and for calculating the Un-used commitment amounts ensuring accurate data flow to down- stream reporting systems for critical CCAR/OPTIMA reporting.

▪

▪ Worked On Fixed Income, Equities, Derivatives

TECH MAHINDRA| Business Analyst/Technical Lead) Jan’22 – Jul’23

Worked at Tech Mahindra as Business Analyst/Technical Lead associated with Bank of Nova Scotia project for modernizing the platform to comply with Canadian regulations for KYC & AML. As part of this project the existing manual process of capturing KYC/ AML attributes is digitized to comply with CDD- Customer Due Diligence, KYC- Know Your Customer which form core compliance under AML to verify client identities and assessing risks, while STR- Suspicious Transaction Report flags the potential money laundering both are part of regulatory compliance under OSFI AML regulations in Canadian Banking system.

INDIAN OVERSEAS BANK | Chennai, India Worked at Indian Overseas Bank for 8 years doubled up as Product Owner and Business Analyst, associated in

Jun 2014 – Jan 2022

▪ Roll –out of Core Banking Solution Finacle (10.2). Lead the digital adaption by acting as

SPOC between branch and central development team. Also involved in creating the SOP for product release and conducted training workshops for branch staff to ensure high adoption rates of the new eco-system. Implemented AML and fraud screening processes aligned with RBI guidelines.

▪ ▪ Spearheaded launch of Mobile & Internet Banking applications, enabling UPI, Cards, Wallets,

and Net Banking payment modes.

▪ Managed payment initiation, authorization, success/failure handling, refunds, reversals,

disputes, and chargebacks.

▪ Optimized transaction success rates by redesigning retry logic and improving customer

payment experience.

▪ Collaborated with banks and payment gateways to integrate UPI PSPs, card networks, and

secure APIs for payment initiation and status checks. Implemented OAuth, API keys, and encryption mechanisms to ensure secure authentication.

▪ ▪ Designed routing logic and failover mechanisms to maintain SLA adherence and uptime

optimization.

▪ Managed T+0/T+1/T+2 settlement cycles, including gross vs net settlement calculations. ▪ Applied MDR, platform fees, and GST deductions for merchant transactions. ▪ Coordinated with banks for settlement file processing and handled exceptions/failed

settlements.

▪ Gather user requirements, mapped them to product features and identified functional gaps in

launching the Mobile Banking and Internet Banking application from Zero- to- one across the bank’s customer base catering to both individuals and Entities.

▪ Lead end-to-end development in the transition of manual work flows to digital for Online Loan Processing across Product line (include Retail, Commercial and Agri loan products) which helped in reduced TAT across product category.

▪ Designed spreadsheet based BI dashboards to monitor the product level profitability and

branch –level KPI trends, presenting actionable insights to senior – management for strategic decision making.

▪ Managed high-value Forex and Derivative products for corporate clients, ensuring compliance

▪

with regulatory risk parameters. In-charge of reporting CRR, SLR and other mandatory parameters to regulatory on daily basis at bank level, to comply with regulatory risk compliance of RBI.

AXIS BANK| Hyderabad, India 2014 Assistant Manager

Nov 2013 – Jun

Advised commercial and retail clients for their treasury requirements - offering them plain vanilla forex products and derivative products as per regulatory and group risk guidelines.

Cross selling of retail liability products and 3rd party products such as current account, special savings account, debit cards and mutual funds.

CATHOLIC SYRIAN BANK| Gulbarga, India 2013 Assistant Manager

Oct 2012 – Nov

Handling all aspects of branch operations – Teller, Cash & ATM management, Remittances & Clearing.

Opening of accounts – Savings, Current and deposits in compliance to KYC rules and guidelines.

Handling customer queries and complaints. • Generating revenue through cross selling of other banking products and 3rd party products.

NORTHERN TRUST| Bangalore, India 2012 Portfolio Analyst o Worked with London Accounting Group – as portfolio return analyst. o Handled a portfolio size of USD 25 billion. o Carried out accounting and balance sheet analysis on monthly/quarterly/annual basis for all

Dec 2011 – Oct

the clients.

o Maintained strong relationships with the account managers in London. o SPOC for all the clients in the portfolio and ensured support and service on priority basis.
